# Outsourced

`admin.model.outsourced` · model · parent `—`

> Administrative work performed by an external provider under contract. The internal function stops doing the work and starts governing it, which is a different capability set — the failure mode moves from capacity to contract.


## Characteristics

|  |  |
|---|---|
| typical_cycle_days | 5 |
| committee_size | 2-4 approvers across both organisations |
| decision_style | contractual; anything outside the statement of work is a change request |
| primary_channels | `portal`, `email`, `scheduled_review` |
